trials.claim: Buyers get free lifetime updates with no subscription
trials.claimQuote: 32,000+ icons with free lifetime updates -- yours forever, no subscriptions
trials.reasoning: A buyer says lifetime buyers receive an expanding and updating collection, and the vendor's terms reference a Lifetime Bundle and All-Access Lifetime Membership. The generic right-to-amend clause and one report of the web app not working do not show lifetime buyers were charged a subscription or denied updates.

exhibits.quote: flat-icons.com reserves the right to amend any information, including but not limited to prices, technical specifications, terms of purchase and product or service offerings without prior notice.
exhibits.argument: This lets the vendor change offerings and terms at any time, undermining a promise of free lifetime updates with no subscription.

exhibits.quote: Web app is not working for few months.
exhibits.argument: Ongoing loss of access to the web app contradicts continued lifetime updates and access.

exhibits.quote: Read our License agreement for Lifetime Bundle (Basic, Commercial, and Agency License) & All-Access Lifetime Membership here: https://flat-icons.com/license/
exhibits.argument: Vendor terms confirm a Lifetime Bundle and All-Access Lifetime Membership exists.

exhibits.quote: One of the most remarkable aspects of Flat Icons is the commitment to expanding and updating the collection, particularly for those who have invested in lifetime access.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms lifetime buyers receive ongoing expanding and updating collection.

trials.claim: Lifetime access to 30,000+ 2D, 3D, and Animated icons
trials.claimQuote: Lifetime access to Flat Icons - 30,000+ icons (2D, 3D, and Animated)
trials.reasoning: Buyers directly say the lifetime 30,000+ 2D, 3D and Animated claim is not accurate and that 3D animated graphics are not included in the base package. The vendor saying it has over 50k assets overall and makes those styles does not show lifetime buyers get access to them.

exhibits.quote: Lifetime access to Flat Icons - 30,000+ icons (2D, 3D, and Animated) is not accurate.
exhibits.argument: Buyer directly reports the lifetime 30,000+ 2D, 3D and Animated claim is not accurate.

exhibits.quote: There are some nice 3D animated graphics, but they are not included in the base package.
exhibits.argument: This shows 3D animated content is excluded from what buyers actually receive.

exhibits.quote: Choose from over 50k assets, free and premium.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states over 50k assets, which supports 30,000+ quantity.

exhibits.quote: We’re a team of creative individuals who make 3Ds, 2Ds, animations, and other cool stuff.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states it makes 3Ds, 2Ds and animations, matching 2D, 3D and Animated styles.

trials.claim: Product includes 32,000+ icons in 2D, 3D, and Animated styles
trials.reasoning: Buyers report the lifetime product has no 3D animated icons and provides only about 1/6 of the website selection. The vendor's total website asset count does not show the delivered product includes 32,000+ icons in all those styles.

exhibits.quote: The lifetime space member is very different from the website and there is not 3d animated icons.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the delivered product lacks 3D animated icons promised in the 32,000+ claim.

exhibits.quote: what you are getting is just 1/6 of the total selection on the website.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports receiving only a fraction of the advertised collection, undermining the 32,000+ count.

exhibits.quote: Choose from over 50k assets, free and premium.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states over 50k assets, which supports 32,000+ quantity.

exhibits.quote: We’re a team of creative individuals who make 3Ds, 2Ds, animations, and other cool stuff.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states it makes 3Ds, 2Ds and animations, matching claimed styles.
